headline: Apartments worth over 4 billion won to pay more comprehensive real estate tax; residence deduction to be abolished in 2028 [2026 Tax Reform]
summary: The government will fully switch to residence-based real estate taxation from 2028. Homes valued at 4 billion won or more would face tax rates rising by up to nearly twofold.
why: Real estate taxation shapes household wealth, housing demand and property-market prices, which matter to banks, developers and construction investors in Korea.
